title: Multigenerational evidence of X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita due to a novel NR0B1 frameshift.
authors: Tian, Lang; Mei, Jie; Zheng, Xi; Dai, Hong-Mei
one_liner_zh: 该文报道NR0B1基因新移码突变导致X连锁肾上腺发育不全的家族遗传分析，纯临床遗传学与测序验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUD: Pathogenic NR0B1 variants, encoding DAX-1, are a major cause of X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita (AHC), yet genotype-phenotype variability persists. RESULTS: In a Chinese four-generation pedigree, two affected males carried a novel NR0B1 frameshift, c.573_576dup4 (p.T193Gfs*13). Segregation showed wild-type fathers and heterozygous carrier mothers, and unaffected male relatives lacked the variant. The duplication shifts the reading frame from residue 193 and introduces a premature stop at residue 205, truncating DAX-1. Pedigree analysis supports NR0B1 c.573_576dup4 (p.T193Gfs*13) as a novel AHC-causing variant. CONCLUSIONS: This maternally inherited frameshift underlies AHC in this family, expanding the NR0B1 mutational spectrum and underscoring genetic testing.
abstract_zh: 背景：致病性NR0B1变异（编码DAX-1）是X连锁先天性肾上腺发育不全（AHC）的主要原因，但基因型-表型变异性持续存在。结果：在一个中国四代家系中，两名患病男性携带一种新型NR0B1移码变异，c.573_576dup4（p.T193Gfs*13）。分离分析显示野生型父亲和杂合子携带者母亲，未受影响的男性亲属缺乏该变异。该重复从第193位残基起改变阅读框，并在第205位残基引入提前终止密码子，导致DAX-1截短。家系分析支持NR0B1 c.573_576dup4（p.T193Gfs*13）为一种新型AHC致病性变异。结论：这种母系遗传的移码变异是该家族中AHC的基础，扩展了NR0B1突变谱，并强调了基因检测的重要性。
